AutoFlowMate is a free, open-source (MIT) automation tool for Windows PCs: files, Excel, PDF, Word, e-mail, web pages and any Windows program, built in a visual flowchart editor or recorded like a macro.

## Download

**`AutoFlowMate-v0.4.3-windows-x64.zip`** is a portable build with no installer. Unzip it anywhere and run `autoflow-studio.exe`. Keep `autoflow.exe` in the same folder. Check the download with its `.sha256` file, or with `gh attestation verify AutoFlowMate-v0.4.3-windows-x64.zip --repo SRathinaGiri/AutoFlowMate`.

## What's new since 0.4.2

### Studio in 17 languages

**View › Language** now offers, besides English and Tamil:

- **Indian:** Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati
- **International:** Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese

They cover the menus, toolbar, panels, action categories, common fields and dialogs (field help stays in English for now). The translations are machine-assisted: corrections from native speakers are very welcome, and each is a plain text file in `lang\`. Right-to-left scripts (Arabic, Urdu, Hebrew) don't display correctly yet, so they aren't included.

### AutoFlowMate for more AI assistants

- **Antigravity CLI:** `agy plugin install https://github.com/SRathinaGiri/AutoFlowMate`
- **Gemini CLI:** `gemini extensions install https://github.com/SRathinaGiri/AutoFlowMate` (this release is the first one that includes the extension manifest)
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add SRathinaGiri/AutoFlowMate`, then `/plugin install autoflowmate@autoflowmate`. The plugin now lives in its own folder (`skills/autoflowmate`), with an icon and links to the documentation, support, privacy policy and licence.

### Maintenance

- The release workflow checks that the program and all plugin manifests carry the same version, and uses the current build-provenance action.

## Upgrading

Flows, tokens and vaults from 0.4.x work unchanged.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, x64.
- Web actions need Microsoft Edge (preinstalled) or Google Chrome. `outlook_send` and `outlook_read` need classic Outlook.
